questiontext.text: Which of the following promises were included in God's covenant call to Abram in Genesis 12:2–3? (Select all that apply)

generalfeedback.text: God promised to make Abram a great nation, bless his name, and bless all families of the earth through him. He was never promised the throne of Egypt.

name.text: W04_Q18: Christian Religious Studies JSS1 Assessment

questiontext.text: Which companions journeyed with Abram when he departed from Haran toward Canaan? (Select all that apply)

generalfeedback.text: Abram took his wife Sarai, his nephew Lot, and their households and possessions (Genesis 12:5). High Priest Eli lived many centuries later.

questiontext.text: Match each place with its role in the account of Abraham's journey of faith:

generalfeedback.text: Ur was the origin; Haran was the departure city; Shechem was the first altar site; and Bethel was where he pitched tent and worshipped.

questiontext.text: Match each covenant personality with their specific relation to Abram:

generalfeedback.text: Terah was father; Sarai was wife; Lot was nephew; and Haran was brother/Lot's father.
